items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: Gastell went over to Mart Ruby who at that time was his assistant

ctx.x: piano furiously. This is the statement she said, that Carlos Gastell walked over to the gentlemen who owned the club, which were two French brothers and said, "Who is the woman playing the piano?" So they told him, gave him my name. This was what she said, which was not true at all. I don't know why I should have even come into the picture, because it wasn't necessary to even mention my name. The story was Nat King Cole's autobiography, you know, so it really wasn't necessary, unless you could add or say…

But Mrs. Cole went on to state that Carlos Gastell asked how much was I being paid, and this proprietor of the club -- this is in this autobiograph -- says, "How much are you paying her?" So the proprioetor says, "We are paying her $125.00 a week." And said, Gastell went over to Mart Ruby who at that time was his assistant -- he also was a road manager.

He used to take care of Nat's people on the road, you know, particularly Nat. He travelled with Stan and some of the other people too, but particularly Nat King Cole. He handled Nat's road business, road manager. He was a very fine road manager. Incidentally, he's still around too. He's still around Los Angeles, from what I hear.
